usageNotes: Returns the directory index of the auto-install API resource, listing available child endpoints under /auto-install. Use this as a discovery call to confirm which auto-install sub-resources the PDM instance exposes before calling more specific operations. Accessible by all authenticated users; no elevated privileges required.
tips: This endpoint returns null per the spec — the directory index response body may be empty or minimal; treat it as a structural probe rather than a data-bearing call.
No parameters are accepted; any query string values will be ignored.
